body.statement: If one role is fixed in advance, or if \(|d|\to\infty\) so that one role is selected with probability tending to one, the selected limit and its symmetric-Wald coverage reduce to the fixed-role normal and nominal-coverage result; the gap-split estimator reduces as a construction to fixed-role late-block proximal inference, with its declared sample-splitting variance rather than the full-pre-period efficiency bound.
body.justification: The reduction verifies compatibility with the published predetermined-role theory and makes the efficiency cost of splitting explicit.
body.gap: The reduction is a required sanity check rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It lets applied users interpret the correction as ordinary fixed-role proximal inference away from the selection boundary.
